$description: TetherLog design tokens. Owned by this repo, no upstream. PHASE 2: the colour and type values here are still the ones NIL rendered, on purpose - this phase proves the pipeline before the design changes. Phase 3 swaps them for the chosen direction. See docs/UI-OVERHAUL.md.

page.$description: Page ground. Ink on it measures 17.67:1.

rule.$description: Borders. Same value as ink today; separated so the design pass can move one without the other.

base.$description: FAILS WCAG AA: 3.96:1 as text on page, 4.44:1 with on-accent on it. Carried unchanged through Phase 2 so this phase is provably a no-op. Fixed in Phase 3.

contrast.$description: Violates .cursorrules' ban on pure white. Same reason: Phase 3 fixes it.

later.$description: 8.89:1 with ink on it. Only 1.99:1 as text on page, so never use it as text.

do.$description: 6.33:1 with ink on it. Only 2.79:1 as text on page.

danger.$description: Destructive only. Never a triage bucket.

base.$description: Tailwind v4 derives the WHOLE spacing scale from this single value. Never define individual --spacing-N alongside it; see CLAUDE.md.

none.$description: Everything, today. The brutalist lock left with NIL; Phase 3 may change this.

width.$description: What actually renders. DESIGN.md claimed 2px for months.

body.$description: PHASE 2 HONESTY: NIL named 'IBM Plex Sans' and never loaded it, so system-ui is what has always rendered. Named accurately here rather than aspirationally. Phase 3 brings a real, self-hosted face.

mono.$description: Same story: 'IBM Plex Mono' was named, never loaded.

motion.$description: Direction-agnostic: these survive whichever look is chosen. Springs are {stiffness, damping, mass} and are solved at build time into CSS linear() easings by scripts/build-tokens.mjs. Zero runtime cost. Named for the moment in the arc they serve, never for their shape.

focus.$description: Is it listening? Zeta 1.000, ~230ms, no overshoot. Certainty, not personality.

commit.$description: Did it take it? Zeta 0.740, ~320ms, 3.2% overshoot. The ONLY token allowed to overshoot. Mass above 1 on purpose: a thought handed over should have weight.

settle.$description: Can I go now? Zeta 1.004, ~270ms. Starts at +120ms so it overlaps commit; total arc 420ms.

dismiss.$description: Leaving without ceremony: chip deselect, error clear, triage card exit. Zeta 1.010, ~200ms.

confirm.$description: How long the confirm word holds under full motion.

confirm-reduced.$description: Longer under reduced motion: the word carries more of the answer.

legacy-file.$description: The existing file-into-stack keyframe. Replaced in Phase 4 by the spring arc.

standard.$description: Non-spring transitions: colour, opacity off the arc.

legacy-file.$description: The existing file-into-stack easing. Dies in Phase 4.

semantic.$description: Roles. Components read ONLY these. Names are deliberately direction-neutral so Phase 3 can repoint them without renaming anything downstream.
